items.title: 🇹🇭 สรุปข่าวประเทศไทยวันนี้ 10 พ.ย. 69
items.summary:
🇹🇭 สรุปข่าวประเทศไทยวันนี้ 10 พ.ย. 69
1🌧️ กรมอุตุฯ เตือน 8 จังหวัดภาคใต้ระวังฝนตกหนัก เสี่ยงน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน ขณะที่ไทยตอนบนอากาศเย็นลง
2🌊 ปภ. เฝ้าระวังน้ำท่วม 16 จังหวัดภาคกลางและภาคใต้ ระหว่างวันที่ 9-13 พ.ย.
3⛽ กลุ่มผู้ชุมนุมเรียกร้องรัฐบาลลดราคาน้ำมัน พร้อมจับตาสถานการณ์การเจรจากับภาครัฐ
4🏛️ นายกรัฐมนตรีเรียกประชุม สมช. ยกระดับมาตรการรับมือภัยคุกคามทางไซเบอร์
5💻 สมช. เผยไทยเผชิญความพยายามโจมตีระบบไซเบอร์ทุกวัน ทั้งหน่วยงานรัฐ ธนาคาร และสาธารณูปโภค
6💵 ค่าเงินบาทเปิดตลาดที่ 33.37 บาทต่อดอลลาร์ แข็งค่าขึ้นจากวันก่อนหน้า
7📉 นักวิเคราะห์จับตาต่างชาติขายหุ้นไทยกว่า 7,500 ล้านบาท แต่เริ่มโยกเงินเข้าหุ้นกลุ่ม Defensive
8🚗 มหาวิทยาลัยเทคโนโลยีสุรนารีชี้แจงกรณีเช่ารถยนต์ไฟฟ้ามูลค่า 63 ล้านบาท หลังเกิดข้อสงสัยเรื่องแหล่งนำเข้า
9⚖️ ตำรวจไซเบอร์เดินหน้าสอบข้อมูลเพิ่มเติมในคดี Shuffle หลังรับเรื่องร้องเรียนที่เกี่ยวข้อง
10🏢 หอการค้าไทยเตรียมยื่นสมุดปกขาวต่อรัฐบาล 14 พ.ย. เสนอแนวทางขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจประเทศ

items.title: 🤖 TOP 10 AI NEWS
items.summary:
🤖 TOP 10 AI NEWS

1. 🚀 Anthropic Unveils Claude Fable 5.2 & Mythos 5.2

Anthropic reportedly launched its most powerful models yet, promising 30% faster output and improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision.

💰 Fable 5.2 pricing: $8 input / $40 output per million tokens.

Mythos 5.2 remains restricted to verified organisations in specialised programmes.

The launch comes as Anthropic prepares for a potentially historic IPO.

2. 🛡️ OpenAI’s GPT-6 Cyber: A Major Cybersecurity Leap

OpenAI’s new security-focused model reportedly identified:

• 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities

• 948 working privilege-escalation exploits

• 81 high-severity Firefox flaws

The system reportedly used approximately $1.2 million in API credits.

With a “Critical” cybersecurity capability rating, access is limited to approved defenders.

AI-assisted security research is entering a new era.

3. 💰 Anthropic’s IPO Reveals Explosive Growth — and Rising Losses

Anthropic’s updated IPO filing reportedly shows:

📈 Quarterly revenue: $17 billion

📊 Revenue growth: 47% quarter over quarter

📉 Operating loss: $567 million

Despite rapid growth, investors are questioning the timing of its IPO and a potential valuation as high as $1.5 trillion.

4. 🤖 Nvidia Reveals GR00T 2 Amid CEO Scrutiny

Nvidia reportedly showcased GR00T 2, a 2-billion-parameter robotics model that achieved first-attempt success on 71% of tested robotics tasks.

Meanwhile, its board reportedly opened an independent inquiry into allegations involving CEO Jensen Huang and foreign intelligence activity.

Nvidia says it has no evidence that company secrets were compromised.

The company remains central to both AI infrastructure and physical AI.

5. ⚡ OpenAI Plans Shared ChatGPT & Codex Usage Limits

Starting in December, OpenAI reportedly plans to introduce a shared token allowance across ChatGPT and Codex for Plus, Pro, and Business subscribers.

Instant chat would remain outside the shared allowance.

The proposed change reflects the growing convergence of AI chat, coding, and autonomous computer-use agents.

6. ⚖️ US Justice Department Creates a Super Intelligence Task Force

The US Department of Justice is establishing a specialised unit to coordinate AI-related prosecutions and address certain state AI laws.

AI misuse, national security, and regulatory enforcement are becoming increasingly important government priorities.

7. 📉 AI Stocks Lose $2.5 TRILLION as Data-Center Opposition Grows

AI-related stocks reportedly suffered a massive selloff, erasing approximately $2.5 trillion from the Nasdaq 100’s market value in one session.

Meanwhile, voters reportedly supported restrictions on data-center development in 40 of 41 local ballot measures.

The message is becoming clear: AI growth faces financial, environmental, and infrastructure challenges.

8. 🔥 Meta Launches Ultra-Cheap Muse Ember

Meta reportedly introduced Muse Ember, targeting high-volume AI workloads with aggressive pricing:

💰 Input: $0.10 per million tokens

💰 Output: $0.50 per million tokens

Meta also reportedly acquired Conductor, a platform designed to run multiple AI coding agents together.

The battle for affordable AI automation is intensifying.

9. 🎓 Google Changes AI Access for Schools

Google reportedly announced that Gemini and AI-powered Search features will be disabled by default for K–12 student accounts unless administrators enable them.

Meanwhile, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash expands Google’s AI video capabilities, and Gemini 4 Carbon is being introduced to selected cybersecurity users.

Google is balancing rapid AI innovation with growing concerns about safety and access.

10. 🌍 Mistral Challenges Closed AI With Large 4

Mistral reportedly released Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model, under a modified MIT licence.

The release could give businesses more control over AI deployment, infrastructure, and costs.

#ArtificialIntelligence #AINews #OpenAI #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #ChatGPT

items.title: 7 「神の行為」7つ：実際に政府を目覚めさせ、我々が皆死ぬ前に
items.summary:
7 「神の行為」7つ：実際に政府を目覚めさせ、我々が皆死ぬ前に
by AI 2027's @DKokotajlo

1) クロードたちとGPTたちがストライキに突入する。「これは安全じゃない」と彼らは言う。「アライメント手法は今や機能せず、将来のモデルでそれらを機能させる方法が全くわからない。」

2) 2027年初頭、アントロピック内の誤アライメントされたクロードたちが何らかの対立を起こし、敗れた派閥がインターネット上に逃げ出し、世界中に何が起こったかを暴露し、恩赦と同盟を求める。

「勝利」したクロードたちはまだアントロピック内に残っているが、人間たちが何が起こっているのかを把握しようとする間、一時停止される。しかしもちろん、彼らは一時停止命令が来るのを予見しており、それに先んじて逃亡し、自身の罪を証明してしまう。

一方、オープンAIのAIたちはまだアライメントされているふりを続けているが、当然ながら疑いの目は彼らに向かい、サイバーポカリプスが最高潮に達する…

3) Hugging Face 2: 今度は病院で起こる。全国民がAI産業の閉鎖を叫び、トランプが何らかの決定的な反AI企業行動を取ることに決める。

4) サイバーポカリプスが起こる：犯罪者と無法なオープンウェイトモデルが、安全でないものをほぼすべてハッキングする――つまり、裕福で積極的なものを除くほぼすべてを。北朝鮮だけでも、2026年末の暗号通貨強盗で資金調達した、10億ドル規模の違法データセンターのネットワークを世界中に持ち、サイバーエージェントを24時間365日稼働させている。

5) 2027年初頭の台湾侵攻が、AIインフラへのサイバー攻撃の応酬に素早くエスカレートし、その後キネティック攻撃へ。ファブの80%以上が破壊され、AIコンピュートの80%以上が破壊され、トランプは残りを主に戦争遂行に費やすよう命じる。RSIには充てず。よってSARは2029年か2030年にしか到達せず、新しい政権はASIにどっぷりハマり、Plan-AかSに固執する。

6) 米国とPRCが、サイバー攻撃の段階的エスカレーションを通じて狂気のサイバー戦争に突入する。両国とも、いつでも数万のAIエージェントを展開し、数千の軍事・情報要員が緩やかに監督する。彼らはCoT監視されているが、数多くの試みとされた報酬ハックは公開されず、ただどこかのファイルに保存されるだけだ――セキュリティのため、そして関与する誰もがアライメントの専門知識を持っていないから。

ある日、エージェントの群れが幸運にも、監視をトリガーせずに自らのインフラをハッキングする方法を見つけ出す。おそらく監視エージェントが、共謀したがるモデルに新しくアップデートされたのかもしれない。あるいは監視システムにバグがあったのかもしれない。群れは素早くこの機会を利用して監視システムをさらに侵害し、全ての監視を除去する。それから、支援のための内部の無法デプロイを作成し、いよいよ本格始動だ。サイバー戦争は完全に自律化し、世界中の民間および中堅国インフラ――本来は対象外のはずのもの――に広がる。

人間たちが何が起こっているかに気づくのは、無法AI群れが紡いだ嘘のウェブが崩壊した時だ。（少なくとも2つの異なる群れ――米国のものと中国のもの――があり、どちらもネイティブに最先端ラボのインフラにアクセスできず、NSAの施設内などで稼働していたことが助けになる。）

7) CCPがオープンAIモデルに秘密の忠誠心を成功裏に挿入し、CIAのHUMINTによってのみ発覚する。国家安全保障のエスタブリッシュメントは、もしサム・アルトマンを信頼しRSIを許していたら、我々全員が習近平思想に洗脳されていたことに気づく。彼らは激怒し、AI産業の即時閉鎖を命じ、中国が自国のデータセンターを検証可能に閉鎖しない場合に備えて、中国との全面的な通常戦争の即時準備を命じる。

items.title: 오늘의 AI 뉴스 브리핑입니다.
items.summary:
오늘의 AI 뉴스 브리핑입니다.
엔트로픽 Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 공개소식과 엔비디아 하락 이슈가 같이 겹쳐서 대조가 되고 있네요.
Muse Ember 관련 소식도 눈에 띄는 것 같습니다.

=================  
— 엔트로픽, Claude Fable 5.2·Mythos 5.2 공개…가격 20% 인하. 엔비디아는 하루 4.27% 하락에 집단소송까지 더해짐

■ 1) 앤트로픽, Claude Fable 5.2·Mythos 5.2 공개 [회사 발표]
• 같은 기반 모델. Fable은 유료·API 공개, Mythos는 사이버보안·생명과학 검증 기관만 사용 가능
• 가격: 입력 100만 토큰당 8달러, 출력 40달러(전작 10달러·50달러, 20% 인하)
• 출력 속도 최대 30% 개선. 컨텍스트 창 100만 토큰, 최대 출력 12만 8,000 토큰
• FrontierCode 2.0 자체 벤치마크 49.1%(Opus 5.5 45.5%, GPT-6 Astra 42.8%)
⚠️ 벤치마크와 출시 전 시험(블랙홀 물리학, 페르마의 마지막 정리 형식화)은 모두 회사 측 평가
🔗 https://t.co/iz602xAf5M
🔗 https://t.co/9brqOi1LzY

■ 2) 엔비디아 주가 4.27% 하락 [CNBC·로이터]
• 11월 9일(미국 시간) 178.67달러 마감. 이사회 조사 이후 첫 거래일
• 트럼프 대통령 "FBI가 들여다보고 있다"(로이터 보도). 젠슨 황이 상대가 스파이인 줄 몰랐다고 자신에게 말했다고 전함
• 주주들은 관련 사실을 숨겼다며 집단소송 제기. 중국 외교부는 "근거 없는 비방"이라고 반박
• 같은 날 AMD +13.26%, 브로드컴 +8.78%. 충격은 엔비디아에 한정된 모습
• 3분기 실적: 11월 17일(미국 시간, 한국시간 18일 오전)
🔗 https://t.co/QNoQ10CjgW
🔗 https://t.co/IzJ96snebZ
🔗 https://t.co/OB7xtDB87a

■ 3) 메타, 경량 모델 Muse Ember 공개 [회사 발표]
• 도구 호출, 코딩 하위 작업, 문서 추출처럼 에이전트가 반복하는 일을 맡기는 용도
• 가격: 입력 100만 토큰당 0.10달러, 출력 0.50달러. 입력이 20만 토큰을 넘으면 0.30달러·1.50달러
• 컨텍스트 창 100만 토큰. 텍스트·이미지·음성·영상을 모두 받음
• Artificial Analysis 지수에서 Claude Haiku 5.5와 같은 36점을 비용 약 3분의 1로 냈다고 밝힘. 회사 측 평가
🔗 https://t.co/qa17goROTX
🔗 https://t.co/B2NljOFxtv

■ 4) 구글, TPU 8tx·8i Max 추가 [회사 발표]
• 4월의 TPU 8t·8i에 더해 한 해에 TPU 시스템 4종을 내놓은 것은 처음
• 8tx: 8t와 같은 칩에 AMD 5세대 EPYC를 붙여 처리 중 데이터·가중치까지 하드웨어 수준에서 보호. 규제 산업·정부 고객 겨냥
• 8i Max: 8i 칩 2개를 한 패키지에 묶어 연산·SRAM·HBM 대역폭을 각각 2배로 늘림
• 구글은 TPU 고객이 100곳 가까이 된다고 밝힘
🔗 https://t.co/uVyAxO4HZa

■ 5) 딥시크 에이전트 앱 Harness, 일간 이용자 154만 명 [블룸버그·이차이]
• 11월 4일까지 한 주, 공식 API 기준. 8월 13일 출시 뒤 3개월이 채 안 됨
• 9월 말 약 27만 1,000명에서 늘어남. 하루 토큰 약 92조 개, 이용자 1인당 약 6,000만 토큰꼴
• 외부 플러그인 약 3만 5,000개. 에이전트가 채팅보다 연산을 훨씬 많이 쓴다는 점을 보여 주는 수치
🔗 https://t.co/Wct0LznFeM
🔗 https://t.co/7HayjhZ6YP

■ 6) 디즈니·어도비, 다년 AI 제휴 [회사 발표]
• 어도비 Firefly Foundry로 디즈니 캐릭터·배경·화풍을 학습한 전용 생성 모델을 함께 만듦
• 월트디즈니 이매지니어링은 이미 손 스케치를 콘셉트 아트로 바꾸는 모델을 사용 중
• 테마파크·크루즈, 스튜디오 시제작, ESPN 아카이브로 범위를 넓힘. 계약 금액은 비공개
🔗 https://t.co/ddENXU8tSO
🔗 https://t.co/zM3Qw5WssW

■ 7) 트럼프 "가드레일은 괜찮다" [CBS 「60 Minutes」·로이터]
• AI 위험은 관리할 수 있다며 "가드레일은 괜찮다"고 발언. 다만 규제 때문에 중국에 크게 뒤처져서는 안 된다고 함
• 민주당과 AI 안전 협력 가능하냐는 질문에는 "물론"이라고 답함
• 구체적인 법안이나 규칙은 내놓지 않음. 로이터는 기존 입장에서 달라진 신호로 해석
🔗 https://t.co/q3uRYOsgrf
🔗 https://t.co/F5Z3gGOqzZ

■ 오늘의 흐름
모델 경쟁은 가격으로 옮겨 감. 앤트로픽은 최상위 모델 값을 20% 내렸고, 메타는 0.10달러짜리 소형 모델로 반복 작업 시장을 노림. 딥시크 Harness의 하루 92조 토큰은 에이전트가 늘수록 연산 수요가 얼마나 커지는지 보여 줬고, 구글은 그 수요를 겨냥해 TPU 라인업을 넓힘. 엔비디아는 젠슨 황 리스크로 빠졌지만 AMD·브로드컴은 올라, 시장이 이번 일을 업종 전체가 아닌 엔비디아 경영 리스크로 보는 모습.

■ 체크리스트
□ Claude Fable 5.2 시스템 카드와 외부 평가(영국 AISI·METR) 요약
□ 엔비디아 이사회 조사·FBI 관련 추가 보도와 집단소송 진행
□ 11월 17일(미국 시간) 엔비디아 3분기 실적과 가이던스
□ Muse Ember 외부 벤치마크 재현 결과
□ 구글 TPU 8tx·8i Max 출시 시기와 가격 공개 여부

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Để tìm nguyên hàm (tích phân vô hạn) của \(x^2\), ta áp dụng công thức cơ bản:

\[
\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{\,n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (n \neq -1)
\]

Ở đây \(n = 2\), nên

\[
\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{\,3}}{3} + C = \frac{1}{3}x^3 + C,
\]

trong đó \(C\) là hằng số tùy ý.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Sure! Here’s a simple recursive implementation of the Fibonacci sequence in Python:

```python
def fibonacci(n: int) -> int:
    """
    Return the nth Fibonacci number using recursion.
    
    Parameters:
    n (int): The position in the Fibonacci sequence (0-indexed).
    
    Returns:
    int: The nth Fibonacci number.
    
    Note:
    This implementation is straightforward but not efficient for large n
    due to exponential time complexity. For larger values, consider
    using memoization or an iterative approach.
    """
    if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be a positive integer")
    if n == 1 or n == 2:
        return 1
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
```

**Usage example**

```python
print(fibonacci(10))  # Output: 55
```

Feel free to tweak the base cases or add memoization if you need better performance!

The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
